reader_summary.headline: Bloomberg Opinion columnist Barry Ritholtz speaks with Joel Greenblatt.
reader_summary.overview: Bloomberg Opinion columnist Barry Ritholtz speaks with Joel Greenblatt, who serves as managing principal and co-chief investment officer of Gotham Asset Management. Greenblatt is also an adjunct professor at Columbia Business School, where he teaches value and special situation investing, and is the author of numerous best-selling books. His latest is “Common Sense: The Investor's Guide to Equality, Opportunity, and Growth." See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
